Callout.Name: Firearm Sale Reported
Callout.Message: Two males exchanging a weapon in a car park.
Callout.Advisory: One weapon seen, in a bag, no shots fired.

Script.Line: It is a part. It is a spare part for a hobby.
I am selling it to him because he asked for one.
There is no ammunition. Look, there is no ammunition.

Lines.Approach: A bag, a gun and money changing hands. Nobody has fired anything yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
